title: IBPS Clerk CRP CSA-XVI Recruitment 2026
summary: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for Clerical Cadre / Customer Support Associate (CRP CSA-XVI) posts in participating public sector banks. Eligible graduates can apply online through the official IBPS portal before the specified deadline.
highlights: Recruitment for Clerical Cadre / Customer Support Associate (CRP CSA-XVI)
Open to Graduates in any discipline from a recognized University
No Interview stage for Clerical Selection
Online examination process conducted in two stages (Prelims and Mains)
eligibility: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University or equivalent. Operating and working knowledge of computer systems is mandatory (diploma, certificate, or studied computer subject in school/college). The age limit is 20 to 28 years, with standard age relaxation applicable for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen) as per Central Government norms.
howToApply:
1. Go to the official website www.ibps.in.
2. Click on the link for 'Apply Online for CRP Clerical / CSA-XVI'.
3. Complete the New Registration with basic details to receive your Registration Number and Password.
4. Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, and preferred bank preferences.
5. Upload scanned documents including photo, signature, thumb impression, and hand-written declaration.
6. Pay the required application fee online and submit the final form.
selectionProcess: Document Verification & Local Language Proficiency Test

faqs.question: What is the qualification required for IBPS Clerk CRP CSA-XVI?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized University and basic computer operating knowledge.

faqs.question: Is there an interview round in IBPS Clerk selection?
faqs.answer: No, there is no interview for IBPS Clerical / CSA posts. Final merit is prepared solely on the basis of Mains exam marks.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for IBPS Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: The minimum age limit is 20 years and the maximum age limit is 28 years for General category candidates, with relaxations for reserved categories.
